title: Backrooms 24-clip Mode B hallway sequence (C016-C039)
notes: Post-fall handheld POV. Actor body never shown. Used by batch_generate_backrooms.py.

clips.start: Static low tilted 4:3 consumer-camcorder POV on empty Level 0 floor. Damp brown-beige carpet, sickly yellow wallpaper.
clips.end: Same floor plate, slightly more of the yellow wall entering frame.
clips.motion: [First-person POV, shaky tracking] Camera settles on the damp carpet then lifts toward the hallway.

clips.start: View drops low; a hand presses into damp carpet at the bottom of frame.
clips.end: View lifts off the carpet toward a yellow corridor opening.
clips.motion: [Handheld POV] Hand pushes off the carpet; camera rises and faces the corridor.

clips.start: Chest-height forward view into an empty yellow room; sleeve cuff at lower edge.
clips.end: The same room, one doorway larger in frame.
clips.motion: [Shaky tracking] Slow walk toward the nearest doorway.

clips.start: Chest-height forward-facing empty yellow room, sleeve cuff visible.
clips.end: Doorway fills the frame.
clips.motion: [Handheld] Walks toward the opening; breathing on the track.

clips.start: Threshold of a yellow opening, wallpaper wrapping both sides.
clips.end: Inside the opening, corridor stretching ahead.
clips.motion: [POV] View advances into the center opening, walls closing in.

clips.start: Low shaky view down a narrow yellow corridor, floor and wallpaper filling frame.
clips.end: Far fluorescent fixture growing larger.
clips.motion: [Low handheld walk] Bounce forward through the narrow corridor.

clips.start: Corridor continues; a dark side opening on the left.
clips.end: The side opening slides past.
clips.motion: [Tracking] Walk past the dark alcove without entering.

clips.start: View facing backward down the corridor while moving; a hand gestures into frame.
clips.end: Frame lurches down; a hand slaps the wall.
clips.motion: [Handheld] Walks backward talking, then lurches and catches the wall.

clips.start: Forward again, yellow wallpaper and damp carpet.
clips.end: A T-junction ahead.
clips.motion: [Shaky tracking] Resume forward walk toward the junction.

clips.start: T-junction, both arms of the hall identical yellow.
clips.end: Right arm chosen, wall sliding past.
clips.motion: [POV] Pause, then turn right into the matching corridor.

clips.start: Long empty hall, repeating fluorescent rectangles.
clips.end: The fluorescents recede; carpet wetter.
clips.motion: [Continuous walk] Forward momentum, lights passing overhead.

clips.start: A stain on the wallpaper catching the light.
clips.end: The stain fills more of frame, still just wallpaper.
clips.motion: [Slow push] Camera eases toward the stained wallpaper.

clips.start: Pull back from the stain to the corridor axis.
clips.end: Corridor empty again.
clips.motion: [Handheld] Retreat from the wall and continue walking.

clips.start: Wider yellow room with several pillars.
clips.end: A pillar passing on the left.
clips.motion: [Tracking] Move through the pillar room, pillars left and right.

clips.start: Between two pillars, carpet dark with damp.
clips.end: Far wall of the pillar room.
clips.motion: [Walk] Cross the pillar room toward the far wall.

clips.start: Another corridor mouth.
clips.end: Inside, ceiling lower.
clips.motion: [POV] Enter the lower corridor.

clips.start: Faster bounce, walls streaking at the edges.
clips.end: A corner approaching fast.
clips.motion: [Handheld bounce] Walk faster; camera bouncing.

clips.start: Corner, yellow wrapping around.
clips.end: New stretch of identical hall.
clips.motion: [Turn] Swing around the corner without cutting.

clips.start: Distant darkness at the far end.
clips.end: The darkness slightly closer.
clips.motion: [Cautious walk] Approach the dark end slowly.

clips.start: Darkness still distant; fluorescents dying ahead.
clips.end: A step closer, lights flickering harder.
clips.motion: [Slow track] Continue toward the dark, flicker increasing.

clips.start: View rises, darkness filling more of frame.
clips.end: View retreats; darkness shrinks.
clips.motion: [Handheld] Raise the camera and walk backward away from the darkness.

clips.start: Turned around, original corridor behind.
clips.end: Walking the way we came.
clips.motion: [Reverse walk] Turn and walk back, still handheld.

clips.start: Pillar room again from the opposite side.
clips.end: Exit back to the first corridor.
clips.motion: [Tracking] Recross the pillar room.

clips.start: Original narrow hall, slightly more scuffed.
clips.end: Dead-end wall ahead, yellow and close.
clips.motion: [Shaky tracking] Walk until the dead-end wall fills the frame.
